disease_name: Hypertension, Nephropathy in Type 2 Diabetic Patients, Hypertensive Patients with Left Ventricular Hypertrophy
indication: treatment of hypertension in adults and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older, to lower blood pressure; reduction of the risk of stroke in patients with hypertension and left ventricular hypertrophy; treatment of diabetic nephropathy with an elevated serum creatinine and proteinuria in patients with type 2 diabetes and a history of hypertension
single_dose: adults 50 mg - 100 mg, children 0.7 mg/kg (up to 50 mg total)
mechanism_of_action: blocks the angiotensin II type 1 receptor, leading to vasodilation and reduced blood pressure
side_effects: dizziness, headache, fatigue, hyperkalemia, renal impairment, cough, angioedema
unsuitable_population: children less than 6 years of age, patients with estimated glomerular filtration rate less than 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, pregnant women

side_effects: dizziness, headache, fatigue, hyperkalemia, renal impairment, hepatic insufficiency
unsuitable_population: elderly, pregnant women, patients with severe hepatic impairment

disease_name: type 2 diabetes with diabetic kidney disease
